# Generated by tools/cm_generate_town_rights_map_mode.py - do not edit by hand.
# Regenerate after a game update.

# Slot entries resolve rank k to a line, or to nothing: cm_trmm_slot_* for the
# ranked rights list, cm_trmm_bd_slot_* for the same ranking with per-industry
# sub-lines, cm_trmm_ind_slot_* for the industries ranked by coverage.
# The cm_uright_rank_slot and cm_uright_rank_bd_slot copies are identical but
# point at line keys that read the location from the customizable-loc target, so
# the build-location marker can reuse the ranking tooltip where the window root
# is not the row's location.

# Breakdown chips: one entry per (industry, input) resolving to that input's
# share chip for the location's winning option, colored by stored raw-input
# presence (green/red) or white for inputs that are never raw materials.
# Triggers read the location/province and texts are static, so both the
# ROOT.GetLocation and Location line families call the same entries. Chips are
# only evaluated inside tooltips gated on cm_trmm_best_idx / right score > 0,
# the same marked-locations contract the coverage readers rely on.
cm_trmm_chip_tools_coal = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			province = {
				var:cm_trmm_pm_tools = 3
				has_variable = cm_trmm_in_coal
			}
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_chip_y_coal_200
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			province = { var:cm_trmm_pm_tools = 3 }
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_chip_n_coal_200
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}

# Comma-joined "tied with" list per right: cm_trmm_tie_prefix_* shows the
# shared static label when at least one other right ties, and
# cm_trmm_tie_item_<right>_<other> resolves to that other right's name (with a
# leading comma unless it is the first tied item in priority order), or nothing.
cm_trmm_tie_prefix_tooling = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_tie_count_tooling > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_tied_with_prefix
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}
cm_trmm_tie_prefix_jewelry = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_tie_count_jewelry > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_tied_with_prefix
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}
cm_trmm_tie_prefix_naval = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_tie_count_naval > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_tied_with_prefix
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}

	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_diff_tooling__naval = 0
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					cm_trmm_diff_tooling__jewelry = 0
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_tie_name_only_naval
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_diff_tooling__naval = 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_tie_name_comma_naval
	}

		fallback = yes
	}

					cm_trmm_diff_textile__brewing = 0
					cm_trmm_diff_weaponry__brewing = 0
					cm_trmm_diff_book__brewing = 0
				}
			}
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_tie_name_only_artisan
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_diff_artisan__brewing = 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_tie_name_comma_artisan
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}

# Build-location urban-right marker icons: cm_uright_rec_icon resolves the
# recommended right (rank 0), cm_uright_assigned_icon the single granted royal
# right, each to that right's texticon. cm_uright_assigned_item_* is the
# per-right granted-or-blank line the multi-right hover list concatenates.
cm_uright_rec_icon = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_tooling = 0
			cm_trmm_right_tooling > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_tooling
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_jewelry = 0
			cm_trmm_right_jewelry > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_jewelry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_naval = 0
			cm_trmm_right_naval > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_naval
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_textile = 0
			cm_trmm_right_textile > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_textile
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_weaponry = 0
			cm_trmm_right_weaponry > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_weaponry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_book = 0
			cm_trmm_right_book > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_book
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_artisan = 0
			cm_trmm_right_artisan > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_artisan
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_brewing = 0
			cm_trmm_right_brewing > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_brewing
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_masonry = 0
			cm_trmm_right_masonry > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_masonry
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}
cm_uright_assigned_icon = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_tooling
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_jewelry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_naval
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_textile
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_weaponry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_book
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_artisan
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_brewing
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_masonry
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}
